thread:
sophia: Heads-up: were rolling out the Hosted API Stream Adapter + ToolCall v3 integration next week. Initial rollout will be opt-in for 48 hours, then well switch to opt-out if telemetry looks good. :tada:

mari: Sweet. Will older tooling still work?

sophia: Yes. Adapter negotiates versions; default is v3, but it will fallback to v2/v1 when the client declares older schemas.

zaid: Which header should client libs set to force v3?

sophia: Add `X-RW-Tool-Version: 3`. If you set it, the adapter will prefer v3 semantics and batching for tool frames.

mari: Any customer-visible quota or billing changes?

sophia: No billing changes. Performance: streaming frame coalescing reduces round trips; expect ~6-10% token cost reduction for tool-heavy flows.

platform-team: Canary report: 24h canary across two regions, error rate stable, p95 latency improved ~7% for small responses. Alerting created: "Adapter | ToolCall v3" dashboard and SLO (99.9% success).

deploy-bot: release/stream-adapter-1.2 promoted to prod. Canary nodes scaled 10 -> 40.

zaid: Docs/snippets? I need a quick snippet for mobile SDKs.

docs-bot: Drafted migration guide and examples. Quick curl for backend teams: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "X-RW-Tool-Version: 3" 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","stream":true,"input":"classify:..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-adapter
```

mari: SDK releases?

docs-bot: Node + Python patches (v0.9.6) will ship today with header support + concurrency bump to 12. Go/Java follow next week.

sophia: CS/sales note: this adapter enables prefix caching for tool calls and merges streaming frames to reduce round-trips. Recommend we tell customers to test in staging and expect modest cost improvements.

zaid: Deprecation plan for v1?

sophia: Well maintain v1/v2 for 9 months. At month 6 we start in-product nudges and telemetry. Official deprecation notice at month 8.

platform-team: Action items created in #infra: expand canary window to 72h, add request-id tagging to traces, and validate region failover.

mari: Ill draft customer emails + CS playbook.

zaid: Ill run end-to-end tests against regions and report back. If we see regressions Ill paste request ids here.

sophia: Thanks all. Tag @platform-team if you find any issues. If all good after 48h opt-in we flip default to enabled for everyone. :rocket:
